This Privacy Policy explains how the Hummus House app handles information. In short: the App is designed to work offline and does not run its own accounts or servers.
Information we collect

We do not ask you to create an account and we do not collect your name, email address or contacts. Content you create in the App — saved recipes, collections, shopping lists, meal plans, ratings and notes — is stored only on your device.
Purchases

If you buy Hummus House Pro, the purchase is processed by the platform app store (for example Google Play). We receive confirmation that the purchase is valid so we can unlock the feature. We do not receive your payment card details. The store’s own privacy policy applies to that transaction.
Diagnostics

The App does not include third-party advertising or tracking SDKs. If crash reporting or basic diagnostics are enabled in a future version, they will be limited to non-identifying technical data, disclosed here, and consistent with the store’s data-safety declaration.
Backups you create

When you export a backup file, it contains your in-app content in readable JSON. You choose where that file goes (for example another app or storage location). Anyone with the file can read it, so keep it somewhere you trust.
Your controls

items: Delete individual items at any time within the App.
Use Settings → Data → Delete all data to erase everything stored on the device.
Uninstalling the App removes its local data from the device.

Your saved recipes, collections, shopping lists, meal plans, ratings and notes are stored only on your device. They are not synced to any server by us.
This means data can be lost if you uninstall the App, reset or lose your device, clear the App’s storage, or if the device or its storage fails.
Your responsibility

Use Settings → Backup & restore to create a backup file regularly, and keep that file somewhere safe. Restoring a backup replaces or merges data on the current device — read the on-screen summary first.
No liability for loss

To the fullest extent permitted by law, we are not responsible for any loss of data, and we do not guarantee that a backup file can always be restored, for example if the file is edited, truncated or created by an incompatible version.

The App is free. It offers one optional in-app purchase: “Hummus House Pro” (product ID premium_lifetime_unlock), a one-time, non-consumable unlock priced at approximately US$2.99 (the store shows the exact local price and taxes).
How the purchase works

The purchase is a single payment with no subscription, no auto-renewal and no free trial. Once purchased, Pro stays unlocked for the app-store account used, subject to that store’s rules. Use “Restore purchases” after reinstalling or on a new device with the same account.
Refunds

Purchases are processed by the app store, and refunds are handled under that store’s policy — for example, Google Play’s refund window and process. We cannot issue refunds directly because we do not process the payment. If a purchase failed but you were charged, or Pro did not unlock, contact support@hummushouse.app and we will help investigate.
Consumer rights
Nothing in this policy limits any statutory refund or cancellation rights you have under the consumer law that applies to you.
“Hummus House Pro” is the single paid upgrade. Buying it unlocks the following features of the App:

items: Hands-free Cook Mode with per-step timers and screen-awake.
Batch and meal planner, and generating a shopping list from a plan.
Combined shopping lists from more than one recipe, with quantities merged.
Unlimited collections (the free version keeps one).
PDF export and printing of recipe cards and shopping lists.
Offline high-definition recipe photos.

body.text: The free version remains fully usable: browsing all recipes, search and filters, favourites, one collection, a single-recipe shopping list, backup and restore, all settings and all legal information are not locked.

We may add to what Pro includes. We will not move a previously free, essential feature behind Pro in a way that breaks your existing use. Entitlement is checked through the app store and cached on the device so Pro keeps working offline.
Because the App stores your content only on your device, you are in full control of deleting it.
Delete specific items
Remove a saved recipe, a collection, a shopping-list item, a planner entry, a rating or a note directly on the relevant screen.
Delete everything

Settings → Data → Delete all data erases every recipe you saved, all collections, lists, plans, ratings and notes stored by the App on that device. This cannot be undone; export a backup first if you might want the data later.
Uninstalling
Removing the App from a device deletes its local data on that device.
Purchases
Deleting app data does not cancel your Hummus House Pro purchase, which is held by your app-store account. Refund or purchase-removal requests are handled by the app store.
